'''''Koh-Lanta: Viêtnam''''' was the tenth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'', the French version of the reality television series ''[[Survivor (TV series)|Survivor]]''. The season took place in [[Con Dao]], [[Vietnam]]. The two original tribes this season were Do and Vang. For the second time in the show, the men were the red tribe and the women were the yellow tribe. However, two contestants (Véronique and Boris) would be the only members of their gender in their tribe.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.programme-tv.net/news/evenement/koh-lanta-vietnam/10491-koh-lanta-vietnam-decouvrez-les-18-candidats-photos/|title=Koh-Lanta Vietnam : Découvrez les 18 candidats (PHOTOS)|date=August 26, 2010|website=Télé-Loisirs}}</ref> The season premiered on 17 September 2010 and concluded 17 December 2010 where Philippe Duron won the season in a 6-1 jury vote against Claude Dartois to win the prize of €100,000 and the title of Sole Survivor.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.purepeople.com/article/koh-lanta-vietnam-philippe-vainqueur-apres-avoir-ete-malmene-par-kunle_a70195/1|title=Koh Lanta Vietnam : Philippe vainqueur, malmené par Kunlé, et superbe audience !|date=December 18, 2010|website=Purepeople}}</ref>

==Future appearances==
Marine Plissonneau, Claude Dartois and Wafa El Mejjad later returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: La Revanche des Héros]]''. Laurence Pizzocchia and Philippe Duron returned for ''[[:fr:Koh-Lanta : La Nouvelle Édition|Koh-Lanta: La Nouvelle Édition]]''. Dartois later returned for a third time for ''[[Koh-Lanta: L'Île des héros]]''. Dartois returned for a fourth time in ''[[Koh-Lanta: La Légende]]''.
